blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Transfer learning from natural images is standard in supervised and increasingly adopted in self-supervised medical image analysis, but its role in generative modelling, and in particular diffusion denoisers, remains underexplored. Medical diffusion models typically train the denoiser from scratch, with no systematic evaluation of natural-image transfer. We analyse this across latent and pixel paradigms, model sizes (131M-952M) and two radiology datasets (RadImageNet, BraTS), and ask which aspects of transfer support generation. We find that: i) Natural-image initialisation consistently improves generation, by 21-34% relative gFID in pixel space against 14% in latent space, where the tokeniser supplies much of the prior. gFID gains mirror downstream pathology classification and radiomic-feature FD, both proxies for clinical fidelity. ii) Benefits reflect spatial structure, not semantics: semantic probing does not predict generation quality, whereas a spatial-structure metric adapted to internal denoiser representations tracks gFID at $|r|=0.85$, positioning spatial organisation as a channel through which pretraining manifests. iii) Mixed-domain denoiser training shows that natural and medical images share similar layer-wise representations up to the late blocks, and mixing natural images into medical training improves fidelity. iv) Transfer benefit is tied to natural image initialisation, outperforming in-domain medical pretraining and several reinitialisation schemes. Overall, natural image denoisers transfer positively to medical ones in our setup. Code is available at https://github.com/CAIROLab-Bern/rad-dit

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Pedagogical drawing textbooks decompose image creation into a small set of basic primitives, e.g . , edges, contours, proportions, and light-and-shade, from which complex scenes can be composed [ 46 , 9 ] . A related principle appears in visual neuroscience, where neurons in early visual cortex respond to low-level features such as oriented edges [ 22 , 23 ] , which are present in any visual input, whether a natural photograph or a medical scan.
blocks.zh: 教学绘画教科书将图像创作分解为一小组基本原始,如边缘,轮廓,比例,和光影等,从中可以组成复杂的场景[46,9]. 相关的原理出现在视觉神经科学中,早期视觉皮层中的神经元响应了诸如向上边缘等低等特征[22,23],这些特征存在于任何视觉输入中,无论是自然相片还是医学扫描.

blocks.en: Domain expertise is built on top of this shared perceptual basis. Radiologists, for example, acquire domain-specific pattern-recognition skills through extensive exposure to medical images [ 65 , 1 ] , but this advantage does not generally extend to non-radiological visual search tasks [ 47 ] . This suggests a distinction between broadly reusable visual primitives and learned domain-specific expertise.
blocks.zh: 域内专门知识建立在这种共同认识的基础上。 例如,放射学家通过广泛接触医疗图像而获得特定域的图案识别技能[65, 1],但这一优势一般不会扩展到非放射视觉搜索任务[47]. 这表明了广泛可再用视觉原始物与所学领域特有专长之间的区别.

blocks.en:
A similar pattern motivates transfer learning in computer vision.
Initialising from ImageNet (IN) [ 6 ] is the standard approach in supervised medical imaging. Early works on convolutional models find that transfer benefits are modest, mostly faster convergence and reuse of low-level (generic) features [ 53 , 25 ] . Mustafa et al . [ 44 ] identify scale as a crucial factor for transferability. Matsoukas et al . [ 39 ] extend
their analysis to convolutional [ 13 , 32 ] and transformer [ 64 , 8 ] models and find feature reuse to be the main source when transfer helps, especially for smaller datasets and closer domains. Interestingly, transformers rely on feature reuse more than convolutional networks.
In self-supervised (SSL) medical imaging, natural-image encoders are increasingly used as initialisation or off-the-shelf, at times matching domain-specific models [ 67 , 24 ] .
For generative modelling, however, and diffusion denoisers in particular, the role of transfer remains underexplored.

类似的模式激励了计算机视觉中的转移学习.
从ImageNet(IN)[6]初始化是监督医学成像的标准方法. 早期关于分流模型的著作发现,分流效益不大,大部分是更快速地收会和再利用低等(基因)特征[53,25]. Mustafa等人[44]认为比额表是可转让性的关键因素。 Matsoukas等人[39] 延伸

在自控(SSL)医学成像中,自然成像编码器被越来越多地用作初始化或现成,有时与特定域模型相匹配[67,24].
然而,对于基因建模,特别是扩散的分泌物来说,转移的作用仍然没有得到充分的探讨。

blocks.en:
State-of-the-art diffusion generative models fall into two broad paradigms: pixel diffusion and latent diffusion . Pixel diffusion applies the denoiser directly to pixels. Latent diffusion pairs a tokeniser with a denoiser that operates in its latent space.
In latent diffusion , natural-image priors can be transferred through the tokeniser, the denoiser, or both.
In the medical domain, natural-image tokenisers have been reused, and a few works fine-tune pretrained text-to-image denoisers [ 3 , 70 ] .
Yet denoiser transfer remains uncommon [ 52 , 21 , 16 , 36 , 66 ] and is treated as an implementation detail rather than a studied phenomenon.
Whether natural-image denoiser transfer is beneficial for medical image generation, and which aspects of the pretrained model account for any observed benefit, remain open questions.

blocks.en:
In this work, we study natural-image denoiser transfer for medical image
generation. Our analysis revolves around two broad questions: do natural
denoisers transfer to the medical domain, and if so,
what is it that transfers and how?
We address these across latent and
pixel-space, model sizes ( 131 131 M– 952 952 M), and two radiology
datasets ( RadIN ; BraTS ).
Our results show a positive transfer, and suggest that the benefit is tied to natural-image initialisation and manifests as better spatial organisation of the internal denoiser representations. We centre our analysis on pixel denoisers, with parallel results for latent ones.

blocks.en: 2.1 Diffusion and Flow Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 传播和流动模式

blocks.en:
Diffusion [ 59 , 18 , 60 ] and flow models [ 37 , 35 ] generate data from noise.
To do so, they are trained to reverse a forward noising
process of data towards noise. The networks that approximate this denoising process are denoisers .

为此,他们接受了扭转前进点名的培训。

blocks.en:
Latent-space denoising. Latent denoisers operate in the latent space of a visual tokeniser, typically a Variational Autoencoder
( VAE ) [ 27 ] , which reduces spatial
dimensionality and computational cost relative to pixel-space diffusion.
Esser et al . [ 11 ] propose a VQ-GAN to compress the image space into a discrete codebook, trained with additional perceptual and patch discriminator [ 14 ] loss.
Rombach et al . [ 54 ] use a continuous, KL-regularised VAE latent space with a U-Net denoiser [ 55 ] . VA-VAE [ 69 ] improves the latent space structure while achieving larger spatial compression (16 × \times ), by aligning it with DINOv2 features [ 48 ] .
On the denoiser side, Peebles et al . [ 50 ] replace the U-Net backbone with a Diffusion Transformer ( DiT ), and SiT [ 38 ] extends it to flow objectives. LightningDiT ( LDiT ) [ 69 ] proposes training and architectural advancements on top of the vanilla DiT architecture.
Here, we couple LDiT with different VAE s, and study whether the denoiser benefits from natural-image transfer beyond the prior already provided by the tokeniser.

We use JiT as our pixel-space denoiser, and, to the best of our knowledge, are the first to transfer it to the medical domain.

We observe an analogous pattern for natural-image initialisation.
Joint-denoising methods model images and features together. We employ V-Co as a joint image-feature denoising baseline and, to the best of our knowledge, are the first to study this paradigm for medical image generation.

blocks.en: Transfer learning in medical imaging. Natural-image transfer is well studied in medical image analysis, where gains are often linked to faster convergence, scale, and feature reuse [ 25 , 53 , 44 , 39 ] . More recently, SSL natural-image encoders have also been transferred as initialisation or off-the-shelf for medical tasks, with competitive results compared to domain-specific models [ 67 , 24 ] . In contrast, we study transfer for generative modelling, focusing on whether natural-image denoisers transfer to medical generation and what transfers.
blocks.zh: 转学医学成像学. 自然图像传输在医学图像分析中得到了很好的研究,其中收益往往与更快的聚合,规模,特征再利用[25,53,44,39]相关. 最近,SSL自然成像编码器也作为初始化或现成的医疗任务被转移,与特定域的模型相比,具有竞争性的结果[67,24]. 与此相对照,我们研究基因模型的转移, 重点是自然成像的去除者是否转移到医学生成, 以及什么转移。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion & Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 结论和讨论

blocks.en:
We present a systematic study of natural-image denoiser transfer for medical image generation. IN transfer consistently improves generation performance across latent and pixel space, model
scales, and two radiology datasets.
Gains are also mirrored in radiomic distance and pathology classification.
Models trained from scratch reach similar semantic probe accuracy yet generate worse samples, whereas spatial organisation, measured by LDS c , correlates
with gFID at | r | = 0.85 |r|{=}0.85 , positioning spatial structure as a channel through which pretraining
manifests. Although natural and medical images differ in high-level content, a mixed-domain denoiser computes similar representations for both through most of the network, and mixing natural images into medical training improves fidelity. The benefit is tied to natural-image initialisation, and no alternative we test reproduces it, including in-domain medical pretraining. From a generative modelling lens, natural images are very useful for medical image generation.

将空间结构定位为预训通道
名单 虽然自然图像和医学图像在高层次内容上有所不同,但混合域的denoiser通过大部分网络计算出相似的表示,将自然图像混合到医学培训中可以提高忠诚度. 福利与自然成像初始化有关,我们没有其他选择可以测试复制,包括域内医学预训. 从基因建模透镜来看,自然图像对医学图像生成非常有用.

blocks.en:
Limitations and future work. LDS c predicts about two-thirds of the pretraining benefit, so spatial organisation is one channel through which it manifests, but might not be the full account. What exactly is inherited (edges, textures or contours), and how architecture, data, training budget and optimisation contribute, remains open.
Moreover, whether the benefits of natural images can be learned from medical data alone remains an open question.
Our extrapolation scales data quantity, not diversity.
Furthermore, our clinical evidence relies on proxies, and expert clinical evaluation is needed before any claim of clinical utility.
Finally, we study 2D generation, the native format for X-ray and histopathology, in which even volumetric scans are read slice by slice. Extending to 3D generation is a natural next step.
blocks.zh:
限制和今后的工作。 LDS c预测预训惠益的三分之二左右,因此空间组织是它表现的渠道之一,但可能不是完整的账户. 究竟继承了什么(边缘、纹理或轮廓),以及建筑、数据、培训预算和优化如何作出贡献,仍然开放。
此外,仅从医疗数据中是否可以了解自然图像的好处仍然是一个有待解决的问题。
我们的推算尺度是数据数量,而不是多样性。
此外,我们的临床证据依赖于代理,在声称临床效用之前需要专家的临床评估。
最后,我们研究了2D生成,即X射线和组织病理学的原生格式,其中连体积扫描都是切片读取. 扩展到3D代是自然的下一步.

Theoretically, an optimal compressor approaches the Kolmogorov complexity of its training data: it learns patterns rather than memorising, and reuses them to compress OOD data. We find natural VAEs compress radiology images very well with no medical training.

We follow the definitions of subsection 3.3 and use the reference implementation of [ 58 ] . JiT tokenises a 256 × 256 256{\times}256 image into a 16 × 16 16{\times}16 grid of N = 256 N{=}256 patch tokens. In-context (class) tokens are removed before computing the metric.
Near pairs are adjacent tokens ( d i ​ j = 1 d_{ij}{=}1 , i.e . , R n = 2 R_{\text{n}}{=}2 ; 4 4 per interior token) and far pairs have d i ​ j ≥ R f = 6 d_{ij}{\geq}R_{\text{f}}{=}6 ( 195 195 per central token), following [ 58 ] ( Figure 10 a,b). A high LDS c means that nearby patches, e.g . , the fur of a bird or a tissue in an MRI scan, have similar representations, while distant patches differ. For LDS c , we mean-centre the tokens of each image before computing the cosine kernel, so that LDS c is the near term minus the far term of the centred tokens ( Figure 10 c).

blocks, excluding the I/O blocks ( Figure 10 d).
